title: Medication delivery and shipping integrity
rule_summary: A Massachusetts pharmacy may dispense prescriptions by mail or common carrier when otherwise lawful, but the pharmacy must ensure that packing, shipping, transportation, and delivery do not adversely affect medication integrity or stability and must maintain appropriate policies and procedures, including controlled-substance procedures when applicable.
exam_relevance: Tests operational responsibility for medication integrity rather than assuming that use of a lawful carrier transfers that responsibility away from the pharmacy.
common_confusions: A lawful carrier does not relieve the pharmacy of responsibility for medication integrity and stability.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
